description: A markdown editor and knowledge base for LLM wikis, specs and notes — wired to your agent.
greeting:
OpenKnowledge — a markdown knowledge base for LLM wikis, specs and notes.

The `ok` CLI is installed and on your PATH (node is seeded in this box). Store
workflows auto-INSTALL but never auto-configure, so scaffold it yourself:

  ok init          scaffold /workspace + wire up your AI editor (one time)
  ok start --open  serve the web editor
  claude           the agent (complete /login first — the box boots credential-less)
